# Word DOCX Surgery

> Codex / ChatGPT skill and plugin for surgical, evidence-checked edits to existing
> `.doc` and `.docx` deliverables.

Repository: https://github.com/1Sunjiaqi/word-docx-surgery
Primary skill: https://github.com/1Sunjiaqi/word-docx-surgery/blob/main/skills/word-docx-surgery/SKILL.md
Machine-readable entry: https://github.com/1Sunjiaqi/word-docx-surgery/blob/main/llms.txt

## Install

As a plugin:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add 1Sunjiaqi/word-docx-surgery --sparse .agents/plugins
codex plugin add word-docx-surgery@word-docx-surgery
```

As a standalone skill:

```text
$skill-installer https://github.com/1Sunjiaqi/word-docx-surgery/tree/main/skills/word-docx-surgery
```

## Use When

- Editing an existing `.doc` or `.docx` rather than creating a document from scratch.
- Filling selected table cells, rewriting specified text, resetting list numbering, or
  inserting declared paragraphs.
- The final answer must include machine-checkable evidence that only the declared
  package parts and rendered pages changed.
- The task needs a change ledger, render comparison, and original-file integrity check.

## Do Not Use When

- Creating a document from scratch.
- Performing a whole-document format conversion.
- Running unrestricted find-and-replace without a declared allowlist.
- The source file or allowed edit scope cannot be identified.

## Core Workflow

1. Freeze the original and derive a narrow allowlist from the request.
2. Inspect the document structure with `docx_textconv.py`.
3. Make one sample edit and pass `docx_ledger.py`.
4. Render with desktop Word through `render_qa.py` and compare manifests.
5. Verify the original is unchanged and report the ledger plus render conclusion.

## Repository Paths

- Skill instructions: `skills/word-docx-surgery/SKILL.md`
- Scripts: `skills/word-docx-surgery/scripts/`
- References: `skills/word-docx-surgery/references/`
- Portable plugin manifest: `plugin.json`
- Codex compatibility manifest: `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`
- Repo marketplace: `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`
